title: Verify Nginx repository availability or add official key
objective: Ensure the system can locate the Nginx package in the repositories.
rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 may require adding a specific signing key or repository source if not pre-configured for third-party packages like Nginx.
expected_output: Confirmation that the nginx package is available via 'apt search' or that the necessary keys are present.
success_criteria: 'apt search nginx' returns a valid package entry.
